modifications: Shared rigid coordinate conversion and common translation; selected original mesh components concatenated by named organ; display colors and normals assigned. HRA heart/lungs fitted as explicitly approximate thoracic replacements. No deformation or arbitrary placement of BP3D organs. Coincident vertices within 0.00001 mm share indices and smooth normals; first original vertex coordinates retained. Liver segment assembly replaced by an explicitly derived continuous voxel capsule; per-organ derivation and geometric comparison recorded. Separate bowel-only ambient visibility attribute baked by local self-organ ray sampling; positions and indices unchanged.
limitations: Adult male authored atlas, not a population or patient scan.
Official BP3D source has 99% polygon reduction; smooth shading adds no measured tissue detail.
HRA lungs and heart are independently fitted display surfaces, not validated same-donor registration.
The source common hepatic duct element includes the inferior extrahepatic bile route; label reflects combined surface.
Color, pathology and animation are illustrative; no physiological or surgical validation.
Connected visual surfaces do not establish watertight lumens or volumetric finite-element meshes.
Mesentery and added vascular branches retain source component fragmentation; no lumen continuity or physiological flow is inferred.

capsuleDerivation.method: 1 mm surface voxelization; padded grid; one 3×3×3 binary closing; enclosed-volume fill; signed distance Gaussian-filtered with sigma 1.25 mm; marching cubes sampled every 2 voxels; 8 Taubin smoothing iterations lambda=.5 nu=.53; outward winding.
capsuleDerivation.scope: Derived display capsule, not new anatomical ground truth. Original source liver segments retained in the source archive and baseline assets.
capsuleDerivation.distance_method: Vertex-to-triangle distance over 32 nearest triangle-centroid candidates: conservative distance upper bounds, not guaranteed exact nearest triangle. All vertices evaluated in both directions.
capsuleDerivation.directional_exterior_scope: Source-only six-axis extremal vertices in 3 mm projected bins, an approximate exposed-source subset; not exact ray-visibility or proof all source exterior points are included.
capsuleDerivation.reverse_scope: All-source reverse distances include deliberately removed interior segmentation sheets. Their maximum cannot be interpreted as exterior shape error.
capsuleDerivation.shape_claim: No exact Hausdorff error bound asserted. The capsule removes internal sheets and shallow segmentation creases, while respecting the source external scale and registration.

ambientVisibilityDerivation.method: Sixteen deterministic cosine-hemisphere samples per vertex; self-organ triangle rays with 0.2 mm outward origin bias and linearly decreasing 18 mm range; two 35% adjacent-vertex smoothing passes.
ambientVisibilityDerivation.scope: Authored display ambient visibility only, no other-organ occlusion, no coordinate or topology modification, no anatomical or optical measurement.
